entities.name: Codex Petropolitanus Purpureus
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Codex Petropolitanus Purpureus, designated by N or 022, ε19, is a Greek New Testament codex containing the four Gospels written on parchment. Using the study of comparative writing styles (palaeography), it has been assigned to the 6th century CE.
